required_inputs.prompt: Enter Claimed Payout Amount in Rand (e.g. 300000)
Enter Claim Description and Reference Details

chain.name: Step 1: IntakeHandler (Text Field Validation & Claim Registration)

children.name: Log incoming claim submission and initialize payload map
Stage 1A: Mandatory Payload Field Validation
Verify policy_number and customer_email are present and non-empty
Verify category, amount, and description fields are present and non-empty
SubProcess 1A-1: Policy Standing & Initial Triage
Verify policy number and active status in policy registry
Send intake validation confirmation or rejection notice to customer

chain.name: Step 2: AssessmentHandler (Category-Based Team Routing & Checklist Execution)

children.name: Read category key and route claim to matching Life Insurance specialist queue
Stage 2A: Standard Death Benefit Checklist (DeathBenefit)
Verify policy number and active status
Review chronology of events
Check beneficiary reference details
Confirm standard death benefit payout calculation
Stage 2B: Accidental Death & Dismemberment Checklist (AccidentalClaim)
Complete standard policy review
SubProcess 2B-1: Incident & Contestability Investigation
Verify incident report and police reference number
Check policy contestability and exclusion clauses
Stage 2C: Critical Illness & Disability Checklist (CriticalIllness)
Complete standard policy review
SubProcess 2C-1: Parallel Medical Diagnosis Code Check
Verify attending specialist medical diagnosis code
Confirm severity meets critical illness or permanent disability criteria
SubProcess 2C-2: Parallel Hospital & Living Benefit Calculation
Calculate hospital benefit and living payout amount
Verify benefit cap and waiting period compliance
Record specialist response_email outcome message in payload map
Stage 3A: TeamLeadApprovalHandler (Claims Up to R250,000)
Check claimed amount against R250,000 first-level approval threshold
SubProcess 3A-1: Life Team Lead Sign-Off
Confirm all assigned specialist checklist tasks are completed
Sign off claim up to R250,000 or escalate higher amounts to Senior Claims Manager
Stage 3B: SeniorManagerApprovalHandler (Claims Above R250,000)
SubProcess 3B-1: Senior Claims Manager High-Value Review
Audit high-value payout calculation and regulatory compliance logs
Record Senior Claims Manager final executive approval
Stage 3C: Database Persistence & Customer Notification
Persist final claim state and audit history to cloud PostgreSQL database
Dispatch final ResultNotice outcome email and in-app alert
